text: Blue-and-yellow-skinned girl in a baseball cap and headphones, beaming with a happy closed-eye smile while a burger and fries spill out of her hands.

Can you draw me one girl with this funky two-tone skin, blue and yellow, wearing headphones and a baseball cap? She's grinning, totally content, and fumbling a burger so the fries are tumbling out everywhere.
黒髪をベースに緑から水色へと移ろう内側の色が覗く長い髪の少女を一人。前髪は交差し、間から緑の瞳が見え、跳ねたアホ毛が一本。丈の短いドレスの上に羽織ったコートを腰の帯で締め、足元には植物が茂る情景で。
One girl, long black hair streaked with green and aqua underneath, ahoge and crossed bangs, green eyes; short dress under a sashed coat, a plant nearby.

I want a single girl whose long black hair hides green and aqua tones inside it. Give her crossed bangs with eyes peeking through, a little ahoge, green eyes, and dress her in a short dress with a coat tied off by a sash. Pop a plant in beside her.

A chibi swordswoman in a kimono and skirt, brown hair pulled into a high ponytail held by a hairband, gripping her sword as little flying sweatdrops pop around her :3 face, all set against a flat blue background that casts a small shadow.
和装に剣を握ったちびキャラ。茶髪を高い位置で結んだポニーテール、:3の口、慌てた汗、青背景に影。
ちびっこ剣士を頼みたいんだけど、着物にスカート合わせて、茶色の髪を高めのポニーにしてさ。剣を握らせて、:3の口で焦った汗をぴゅっと飛ばして、背景は青一色、足元に影を落とす感じで。
草原に佇むポケモンらしき生き物を一匹だけ。人物は描かず、晴れた昼の屋外で、茶色い瞳と白く光る瞳孔、色のついた白目をのぞかせている。口を大きく開けて牙を見せ、:dのように嬉しそうに笑っている様子で。

No people here, just a single Pokemon-like creature out on the grass in bright daylight, mouth open in a fanged grin, brown eyes with glowing white pupils and colored sclera, looking thoroughly happy.

Could you do just a little Pokemon creature, no humans at all? It's standing in the grass on a sunny day, super happy, mouth wide open with a fang showing, brown eyes that have bright white pupils and tinted sclera.

A solo girl with short blue hair and a single braid, yellow eyes looking right at the viewer, wearing a hat and a white collared shirt with a necktie under long sleeves, a skirt, and a bow clipped into her hair.
青髪ショートで三つ編みを一房、黄色い瞳でこちらを見る少女一人。白い襟シャツにネクタイ、長袖、スカート、帽子、髪に蝶結び。
短めの青い髪で三つ編みを一本だけ垂らした子を一人描いてほしいな。黄色い目でこっちを見ていて、帽子をかぶって、白い襟付きシャツにネクタイ、長袖、スカート、髪には小さなリボン。
英語の台詞が入ったコマ割り漫画で、女の子が二人。片方は黒髪のロング、もう片方は緑髪のショートで、白いシャツやタンクトップ姿。黄色い瞳の子もいて、頬には傷跡。吹き出しが浮かび、片方が眠っている百合めいた空気の一場面を。
Comic panel with English text and speech bubbles, two girls: one long black hair, one short green hair, white shirt and tank top, yellow eyes, a scar, sleeping, with a yuri vibe.

Draw it like a little comic strip with English speech bubbles. Two girls, one with long black hair and one with short green hair, white shirt and a tank top between them, yellow eyes, a scar somewhere, one of them dozing off, and let it read kind of yuri.
A single girl outdoors, her medium-length hair blending blonde and brown, looking at the viewer in a black jacket over long sleeves with a pleated skirt, socks and shoes, a bag slung along.
屋外で一人、金と茶の混じったミディアムヘアの少女がこちらを見る。黒いジャケットに長袖、プリーツスカート、靴下と靴、鞄を提げて。
外にいる女の子を一人、こっちを見てる感じで。髪はブロンドと茶色が混ざったミディアムで、黒いジャケットを長袖の上に羽織って、プリーツスカートに靴下と靴、鞄も持たせてほしい。
二人の少女がこちらを見つめる構図。一人は茶髪、もう一人は黒髪に紫の差した多色の髪でとても長い。長袖の子の隣で、白いドレスをノースリーブで着た青い瞳の子が立ち、V字に寄った眉が意志の強さをのぞかせる。隅に署名を添えて。

Two girls looking at the viewer: one brown hair, one very long black-and-purple multicolored hair; blue eyes, a sleeveless white dress on one, long sleeves on the other, v-shaped eyebrows, signature in the corner.

Two girls facing us, please. One's got brown hair, the other has really long black hair with purple mixed in. Blue eyes, sharp v-shaped brows; put one in a sleeveless white dress and give the other long sleeves, and don't forget a little signature.
白から灰へ流れる髪をポニーテールに結った少女が一人。青い瞳を見開き、口を開けた表情で、袖のない青いジャケットにフードを背負い、黒い指なし手袋とパンツを身につけた活発な装いで。
Solo girl, white-grey ponytail, blue eyes, mouth open; sleeveless blue jacket with a hood, black fingerless gloves and pants.
Let's do one girl with white-into-grey hair tied in a ponytail and bright blue eyes, mouth open like she's mid-shout. Stick her in a sleeveless blue hooded jacket, black fingerless gloves, and pants.
短い茶髪に緑の瞳の少女を主役に据えた一枚。緑のドレスの上から外套を羽織り、覗く手は鋭い爪。鎖骨のあたりに浮かぶハート、ピンク色の背景、画面の外へ少しはみ出す構図で、隅にはツイッターの名前を。
Short brown hair, green eyes, a girl in a green dress and cloak with clawed hands; a heart near her collarbone, pink background, partly out of frame, a twitter handle tucked in.

Focus on one girl with short brown hair and green eyes looking our way. Green dress under a cloak, and her hands have claws. Float a little heart by her collarbone, pink backdrop, let her drift out of frame a bit, and add a twitter username.

Two girls together, one a virtual youtuber with red hair and small horns, hair ornaments throughout; long sleeves and detached sleeves, sleeveless and puffy-sleeved pieces mixed in, skirts, socks, and a belt, their hair shading into other colors.
Vtuber二人、赤毛に角、多色の髪。長袖と取り外し袖、ノースリーブ、膨らんだ袖、スカートに靴下、髪飾りとベルト。
Vチューバーっぽい女の子を二人並べてほしいんだ。片方は赤髪で小さな角、髪は何色か混ざってる感じ。髪飾りをいくつか、長袖と取り外しできる袖、ノースリーブや膨らんだ袖を混ぜて、スカートと靴下、ベルトも添えて。

Upper body of a solo girl with pink twintails of medium length, dressed in a blue Japanese-style kimono with puffy sleeves, holding a scythe; her lips are slightly parted in an expressionless face, paint splatter scattered across the picture.
ピンクのツインテールの少女一人、青い着物に膨らんだ袖、大鎌を手に。上半身、無表情で唇を少し開け、絵具の飛沫。
ピンクの髪をツインテにしたミディアムの子を一人、上半身で。青い和風の着物に膨らんだ袖を着せて、大鎌を持たせてね。表情は無で唇だけ少し開いて、画面には絵具がぱっと散ってる感じに。
長い黒髪に小さな角を生やした少女が一人、こちらを見つめている。肩をあらわにした白と青のドレス、髪を飾るリボンと髪飾り、腕にはブレスレットと宝飾。足元に水が広がる静かな場面で。
Solo girl, long black hair, small horns, looking at viewer; bare shoulders in a white-and-blue dress, hair ribbon and ornament, bracelet and jewelry, water around her.

One girl with long black hair and little horns, gazing at us. Bare-shouldered in a dress that's part white, part blue; tie a ribbon and ornament in her hair, slip a bracelet and some jewelry on, and let water spread at her feet.

Several boys, the focus on one with long brown-and-grey hair tied into a ponytail, hair falling between his eyes, small horns and a tail marking him as something inhuman; he's in an alternate costume with long sleeves and black gloves, looking at the viewer with a weapon at hand.
複数の男子、主役は茶と灰の混じった長髪のポニーテール。角と尻尾、長袖に黒手袋、別衣装、武器を手にこちらを見る。
男の子を何人か、でもメインは茶と灰が混ざった長い髪をポニーにした子で。前髪が目の間に落ちてて、角と尻尾あり、いつもと違う衣装で長袖に黒手袋。武器を持たせてこっちを見る形にしてほしい。

A solo girl in an official alternate swimsuit, wet from the water around her, grinning wide with a :d expression and v-shaped brows. Her two-tone hair runs red into orange with blunt bangs, green eyes catching the light, the whole thing leaning into parody.
水着姿の少女一人、赤とオレンジの二色髪に切り揃えた前髪、緑の瞳。水に濡れ、:dの笑顔とV字眉、公式別衣装のパロディ調で。
公式の別水着を着た子を一人。髪は赤からオレンジへのツートンでぱっつん前髪、緑の目で。水でびしょ濡れにして、:dみたいな大きな笑顔とV字眉、ちょっとパロディっぽいノリで頼む。
獣の耳と角を持つ一人の少年を主役に。白いシャツに黒いベスト、その上から仕立てのよいスーツをまとい、白手袋をはめた手元に爪がのぞく。背後には炎が揺らめき、彼は上を見上げている獣人風の一枚で。
A furry boy with animal ears and horns, white shirt under a black vest and suit, white gloves with claws, looking up, fire behind him, facing the viewer.
Make it a furry guy, animal ears and a pair of horns. White shirt, black vest, a suit over it, white gloves with claws peeking out. He's glancing upward with flames flickering behind him.

A draconic Digimon knight, part robot and part dragon, clad in spiked mecha armor with a single horn and broad wings, a red cape flowing behind. Yellow eyes glint above its clawed hands as it raises a sword.
デジモン風の竜の騎士、機械と竜が融合したメカ鎧。単角と翼、棘、爪、黄色い瞳、剣に赤マント。
デジモンみたいな竜の騎士を描いてくれない?ロボットと竜が混ざったメカっぽい鎧で、角は一本、翼と棘付き、爪のある手に剣を握って。黄色い瞳に赤いマントをなびかせる感じで。
緑髪の少年が一人、深くフードをかぶって片目を隠している。動物の耳を模したフードの下、長袖に手袋をはめた手がナイフを握る。武器を構えた静かな殺気を漂わせ、隅には小さなウォーターマークを。
Solo green-haired boy, hood up with an animal-eared design covering one eye, long sleeves and gloves, holding a knife; a watermark in the corner.
One guy with green hair, hood pulled up so it hides an eye, and the hood's got little animal ears on it. Long sleeves, gloves, and he's gripping a knife. Toss a small watermark somewhere.

A comic-style shot of one man in Japanese clothes worn open, a kimono with a hat, jewelry and a rope, plus a veil; an anger vein pops on his face as a bug appears, facing us straight-on in a meme-like beat with the artist's name signed.
漫画調の男一人、和装の着物をはだけ、帽子と装身具、縄、ヴェール。虫と怒筋、正面向き、ミーム風、署名あり。
漫画みたいなノリで男を一人。着物をだらしなくはだけて、帽子と宝飾、縄、ヴェールをつけて。虫が出てきて顔に怒りマーク、正面を向いた構図で、ちょっとミームっぽく、隅に作者名を入れて。
学校の制服姿の少女たちを複数。スカートにジャケット、髪は様々で、長い子もとても長い子も、ツインテールやポニーテールも交じる。青や緑や紫の瞳、髪を飾るリボンと蝶結びの飾りで、賑やかに並べて。
Multiple girls in school uniform, skirts and a jacket; a mix of long, very long, twintails and ponytail hair, blue, green, and purple eyes, ribbons and hair bows.

A bunch of girls in school uniforms with skirts and a jacket. Vary their hair, some long, some really long, twintails on one, a ponytail on another, and give them blue, green, and purple eyes with ribbons and hair bows.
茶色の長い髪に動物の耳を生やした少女が一人。前髪の隙間から赤い瞳がのぞき、こちらを向いて:dの大きな笑顔。蝶結びとヘアバンド、蝶ネクタイ、黒タイツに靴という装い。ハートを散らし、隅にツイッターの名を添えて。
Solo girl, long brown hair with animal ears, red eyes between her bangs, beaming :d at the viewer; bow and bowtie, hairband, pantyhose and shoes, a heart and a twitter handle.

One girl, long brown hair, a pair of animal ears, red eyes peeking through her bangs, looking at us with a huge :d grin. Add a bow and a bowtie, a hairband, pantyhose and shoes, scatter a heart, and write a twitter username in.
緑の髪を編み込みと片側のお団子にまとめた少女が一人、青い瞳を輝かせている。青いセーラー襟の制服を着て、手には果物を持ち、上の歯だけ見せた笑顔。きらめきとハートが舞い、隅にツイッターの名前を。
Solo green-haired girl, blue eyes, a braid and a single side bun; blue sailor collar, holding a piece of fruit, upper teeth showing in a smile, sparkles and a heart, a twitter handle.

Draw one girl with green hair done in a braid and a bun off to one side, blue eyes. Put her in a blue sailor collar, have her holding some fruit, smiling so just her upper teeth show. Sprinkle sparkles and a heart and tuck in a twitter name.

A solo girl with black hair and cat ears, the fur on them fluffy, a hair ornament and ribbon tied in; she's in a dress with long sleeves, a tail behind her, sticking her tongue out a little near some food, looking at the viewer with the artist's name in the corner.
黒髪に猫耳、耳元はふわふわの少女一人。長袖のドレス、尻尾、髪リボンと飾り、食べ物の前で舌を出し、こちらを見る。署名入り。
黒髪の子を一人、猫耳でその根元がもふっとしてる感じで。長袖のワンピに尻尾、髪にはリボンと飾り。食べ物のそばでぺろっと舌を出して、こっちを見てるポーズ。隅に作者名も入れてね。
白い長髪に小さな角、ぱっつん前髪の少女が一人、赤い瞳でこちらを見据える。前を開けたジャケットを羽織り、ベルトを締め、両手で銃を構えている。武器を持つ姿に油断のない緊張感を。
Solo girl, long white hair with horns and blunt bangs, red eyes on the viewer; open jacket, belt, holding a gun.
One girl, long white hair, little horns, blunt bangs, red eyes locked on us. Throw an open jacket over her with a belt, and put a gun in her hands like she's ready to fire.
黒い長髪に馬の耳を生やした少女が一人、黄色い瞳でこちらを見る。前髪の間から覗く瞳とアホ毛、開いたコートの下にネクタイ、黒い手袋をはめた手にはカップ。落ち着いた佇まいで描いて。
Solo girl, long black hair with horse ears and an ahoge, yellow eyes looking at viewer; open coat over a necktie, black gloves, holding a cup.

Let's see one girl with long black hair, horse ears, a stray ahoge, and yellow eyes meeting ours. Bangs falling between her eyes, an open coat with a necktie underneath, black gloves, and a cup in hand.

A comic with English text and speech bubbles featuring several boys, hair in brown, black, blue and white, short cuts all around; one wears black gloves and a choker with an ascot, another throws up a V sign in a lively exchange.
英語台詞の漫画、複数の男子。茶・黒・白髪のショート、黒手袋にチョーカーとアスコット、ピース、吹き出し。
英語の吹き出し付きの漫画にして、男の子を何人か。髪は茶や黒や青、白でみんな短め。一人は黒手袋にチョーカーとアスコットを着けて、別の子はピースサインしてる掛け合いの場面に。

Three girls together, one blonde with short hair and blue eyes, all decked in jewelry, necklaces, bracelets and a collar; horns on at least one, detached sleeves, thighhighs, pants, belts and a scarf, with bold makeup tying their look together.
少女三人、金髪ショートに青い瞳の子も。角、取り外し袖、ニーソ、パンツ、ベルト、ネックレスにブレスレット、襟、マフラー、化粧。
女の子を三人。一人は金髪ショートで青い目にして、みんな宝飾をじゃらっと、ネックレスやブレスレット、首輪も。角を生やした子もいて、取り外し袖にニーソ、パンツとベルト、マフラー、しっかりめのメイクで。
金髪のロングをした少女が一人、全身が収まる構図でこちらを見ている。ファッション性の高い黒い長いドレスにコルセットを締め、房飾りとポンポンをあしらい、耳には揺れるピアス。仕立て直した装いを誇らしげに。
Solo blonde girl, long hair, full body, looking at viewer; a fashion-forward long black dress with corset, tassels and pom poms, earrings, an adapted costume.

One blonde girl with long hair, shown head to toe, eyes on us. Dress her in a fashionable long black gown with a corset, add tassel and pom-pom details, drop earrings, and treat it like a redesigned outfit.

A solo boy with short black hair in an alternate outfit, the focus on him; he's loaded with jewelry, earrings and a necklace, a bracelet, headphones around his neck and sunglasses, piercings catching the light, his lips drawn with care, a twitter handle in the corner.
黒髪ショートの男一人、別衣装。ピアスとイヤリング、ネックレスにブレスレット、ヘッドホン、サングラス、唇、ツイッター名。
黒髪ショートの男を一人、いつもと違う衣装で。アクセ多めで、イヤリングにネックレス、ブレスレット、ヘッドホンとサングラス、ピアスもいくつか。唇を丁寧に描いて、隅にツイッターの名前も。

A POV shot of two girls, one with long hair and one with green twintails, the green-haired maid in focus with her headdress and puffy short-sleeved uniform, purple eyes, hair falling between them; some food between them and a gentle yuri mood.
POVで少女二人、片方が緑のツインテのメイドに焦点。メイド帽、膨らんだ半袖、紫の瞳、食べ物、百合の空気。
視点はこっち目線で、女の子二人。手前が緑のツインテのメイドの子で、メイド帽に膨らんだ半袖、紫の瞳。間に食べ物を置いて、ふんわり百合っぽい雰囲気に。
白い長髪に青い瞳の少女が一人、前髪の間から瞳がのぞく。帽子をかぶり、フリルの効いた長袖のドレスにプリーツスカートを重ね、胸元には蝶ネクタイと蝶結び。柔らかな雰囲気で、隅に署名と作者名を。
Solo girl, long white hair, blue eyes between her bangs; a hat, frilly long-sleeved dress over a pleated skirt, a bow and bowtie, signed with the artist's name.
One girl, long white hair and blue eyes peeking through her bangs. Give her a hat, a frilly long-sleeved dress with a pleated skirt, a bow and a bowtie, and sign it with the artist's name.
短い髪をボブにそろえた少女が一人、まつげをしっかり描いて、こちらを見て嬉しそうに微笑んでいる。髪飾りと蝶結び、手袋にケープをまとい、シンプルな背景にちょこんと座ったラフなスケッチ調で。
Solo girl, short bob cut with defined eyelashes, smiling happily at the viewer; hair ornament and bow, gloves and a cape, sitting in a sketch against a simple background.
Just one girl with a short bob and nicely drawn lashes, smiling at us all happy. Hair ornament and a bow, gloves, a little cape, sitting down, and keep it loose like a sketch on a plain background.
Two girls who read as siblings, one blonde and one blue-haired with red eyes, in white shirts with frilly vests and ascots, a hat between them and wings; one holds out a piece of fruit.
姉妹らしき少女二人、金髪と青髪に赤い瞳。白シャツにフリルのベストとアスコット、帽子、翼、果物を手に。
姉妹っぽい女の子を二人、片方が金髪でもう片方が青髪、どっちも赤い瞳で。白いシャツにフリル付きのベストとアスコット、帽子と翼をつけて、片方が果物を手に持ってる感じに。
A fox girl seen looking at the viewer, her fox ears and tail out, brown-toned and lively; she wears a jacket over a black skirt and grips a sword two-handed, the piece signed and dated in a corner.
狐耳と狐尻尾の少女一人、こちらを見る。ジャケットに黒スカート、剣を握る。署名と日付。
狐耳としっぽを生やした女の子を一人、こっちを見てる構図で。ジャケットに黒いスカートを合わせて、剣を握らせて。隅にサインと日付も入れてくれると嬉しい。
短い灰色の髪に灰の瞳、眼鏡をかけた男が二人、こちらを見ている。黒いコートに黒いパンツの揃いの装いで、それぞれが剣を手にしている。落ち着いた構えで並ぶ二人組として描いて。
Two boys, short grey hair, grey eyes, glasses, looking at the viewer; black coats and black pants, each holding a sword.
Give me two guys with short grey hair, grey eyes, and glasses, both looking our way. Matching black coats and black pants, and put a sword in each of their hands.
晴れた昼の青空を背に、ちびキャラの少女が二人。一人は黒髪、もう一人は白髪のツインテールで、前髪の隙間から瞳がのぞく。青い瞳とピンクの瞳、頭上に光輪を浮かべ、:dの笑顔で空の下にはしゃいでいる。
Two chibi girls under a blue daytime sky, one black hair, one white twintails; blue and pink eyes, hair between their eyes, halos overhead, grinning :d.

Two little chibi girls outdoors with a bright blue sky behind them. One has black hair, the other white twintails, bangs between their eyes; one's got blue eyes, the other pink, halos floating above, both beaming with :d smiles.
白や灰の髪をした男子を複数、長髪も短髪も混ぜて。尖った耳に白い手袋、フリルとリボンをあしらったドレスめいた衣装にネクタイ、ニーソとベルト、宝飾を添えて、中性的で華やかな一群として。
Multiple boys, white and grey hair both long and short, pointy ears; frilly dress-like outfits with neckties, white gloves, thighhighs, ribbons, belts and jewelry.

A group of boys with white and grey hair, mix of long and short, all with pointy ears. Dress them in frilly, dress-like outfits with neckties, white gloves, thighhighs, ribbons, belts and a bit of jewelry.
黒い長髪の少女と少年が寄り添う一枚。少女は紫の瞳に花の髪飾りと蝶結び、耳には揺れるピアス。少年は赤い髪で、髪は色が混ざり、動物の耳と尻尾を持つ。互いに想い合う異性のカップルとして、開いた衣装で描いて。
A girl and a boy together: she has long black hair, purple eyes, a flower ornament, bow and earrings; he has red hair, multicolored, with animal ears and a tail. A hetero pairing in open clothes.
